headline: Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170
summary: Microsoft announces significant price hikes for Xbox consoles in EU and UK. Increases can be as high as €200 or £170, depending on the model. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is specifically affected.

headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight smart calendars are on sale, offering up to $90 off during a back-to-school promotion. The deal runs from August 2nd through August 9th. These calendars help families manage hectic schedules and responsibilities.

headline: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
summary: HP's new HyperX Omen 15 replaces the previously budget-friendly Victus 15 gaming laptop. While offering upgrades like an RTX 5050, it comes at a higher price point. This suggests it may not retain its predecessor's reputation as an affordable entry-level option.

headline: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
summary: Generative AI startups face ongoing criticism for using artists' work without permission to train models. Artists view this practice as theft, leading to contentious legal battles. The article explores whether compensation for artists can bridge the divide with AI development.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection, Saros, Death Stranding 2, and More
summary: A new roundup highlights the best gaming deals available today. Featured titles include Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection and upcoming details on Death Stranding 2. The article covers various discounts and offers for gamers.

headline: Hideo Kojima Reviews Spider-Man: Brand New Day: 'It Felt Fresh, and I Really Enjoyed It'
summary: Acclaimed game developer Hideo Kojima has published his review for 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.' He praised the take on a 'lonely Peter Parker,' stating it 'felt fresh.' Kojima revealed he 'really enjoyed' the experience.

headline: What the Heck Is Marvel Doing With the Hulk Anyway!?
summary: The article questions Marvel's current creative direction and plans for the Hulk character. This inquiry follows the events of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.' It expresses a sense of bewilderment regarding Hulk's recent storylines.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has shattered box office records. The film earned a massive $168 million on its opening day. This performance surpasses 'Avengers: Endgame' for the biggest domestic opening day ever.

headline: Burnham pledges to be 'relentless' in curbing small boat crossings
summary: Prime Minister Burnham has pledged a 'relentless' effort to curb small boat crossings into the UK. He highlighted increased enforcement measures as a key strategy. Burnham also emphasized the need for more safe and legal routes into the country.

headline: Man admits transporting Scottish woman's body in suitcase, Greek police say
summary: A man has confessed to transporting a Scottish woman's body inside a suitcase. Greek police arrested the individual on suspicion of manslaughter. He also faces charges related to robbery and weapons offences.

headline: Prolonged drought could cause shortage of some foods, farmers' union head says
summary: NFU president Tom Bradshaw warns that prolonged drought could lead to shortages of certain foods. He calls on the government to take action to mitigate the impact of extreme weather. The warning highlights potential threats to the UK's food supply.

headline: Ukraine says major Russian oil refinery and airfield hit, as Moscow reports eight deaths
summary: Ukraine claims successful strikes against a major Russian oil refinery and an airfield. Moscow, in response, reported eight fatalities from Ukrainian attacks. Russia's military also stated it targeted Ukrainian ports and vessels in the Black Sea overnight.
